title: PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_RECEIVE fails with PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_RECEIVE_OFFER_CROSS_SELF
pattern: A transaction whose PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_RECEIVE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (offer_cross_self). The only offer on the CSF/XLM book is the sender's own.

hazards.placement: a path payment whose only route is the sender's own offer

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
